crossRefs.note: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”
Then she said, “Wait, my daughter, until you know what will happen; for the man will not rest until he has settled this…
Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
